What We Do

Comprehensive SAP Group
Reporting Services

From initial implementation to ongoing optimization, we deliver end-to-end expertise to maximize your SAP Group Reporting investment.

SAP Group Reporting Implementation

End-to-end implementation of SAP Group Reporting tailored to your organizational structure, chart of accounts, and consolidation requirements. We deliver fast, proven deployments with minimal business disruption.

  • Chart of accounts design
  • Entity hierarchy setup
  • Elimination rules configuration
  • Go-live support & training

Financial Consolidation Optimization

Streamline your group consolidation process to reduce close cycles, improve accuracy, and provide real-time visibility into your group financial position.

  • Close cycle reduction
  • Intercompany elimination
  • Currency translation automation
  • Minority interest handling

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure full compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, and local regulatory standards. Our experts configure SAP Group Reporting to meet your audit and disclosure requirements.

  • IFRS 10/11/12 consolidation
  • US GAAP reporting packs
  • Statutory reporting
  • Audit trail & data lineage

Data Migration & Integration

Migrate legacy financial data and integrate SAP Group Reporting with your existing ERP landscape, data warehouse, and planning tools seamlessly.

  • Legacy system migration
  • SAP S/4HANA integration
  • BW/4HANA connectivity
  • API & middleware setup

Training & Change Management

Empower your finance team with role-based training programs designed around SAP Group Reporting workflows. Drive adoption and long-term success.

  • Role-specific training
  • Train-the-trainer programs
  • User documentation
  • Ongoing enablement

Managed Services & Support

Ongoing managed services to keep your SAP Group Reporting environment optimized, updated, and performing at peak efficiency year-round.

  • 24/7 technical support
  • Upgrade management
  • Performance monitoring
  • Continuous improvement
